metadata.title: NextForge — full-stack Next.js foundation
metadata.description: Feature-based Next.js starter with i18n, invite-only auth, Postgres, email and object storage.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you’re looking for has moved or never existed.

home.title: Start every product from a finished foundation
home.description: Feature-based architecture, invite-only auth, Postgres, email and storage — wired, typed and secure by default.

i18n.title: Multilingual by default
i18n.body: next-intl with an unprefixed default locale, RTL support and hreflang alternates.

auth.title: Invite-only auth
auth.body: Better Auth with roles, rate limits, password reset and admin-issued invitations.

db.title: Postgres, zero setup
db.body: Drizzle ORM on embedded PGlite locally, any hosted Postgres (Neon) in production.

email.title: Transactional email
email.body: React Email templates sent via Resend, printed to the console in development.

storage.title: Private object storage
storage.body: Presigned uploads and downloads on Cloudflare R2 or any S3, with a local driver for dev.

design.title: Glass design system
design.body: Layered tokens, light and dark themes and accessible primitives.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Primitive palette, semantic tokens and core components. Values are read live from CSS, so this page always matches the code.
designSystem.semanticHint: Toggle the theme in the header: these swatches re-map, the primitives above don’t.

auth.signInDescription: Accounts are by invitation. Use the email your invitation was sent to.
auth.forgotDescription: Enter your email and we’ll send you a secure link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.
auth.resetDescription: Pick something long and memorable. You’ll be signed out everywhere else.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been updated. You can sign in now.
auth.passwordChanged: Password updated. Other devices have been signed out.
auth.inviteDescription: Set a password for {email} to activate your account.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don’t match.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.banned: This account has been suspended. Please contact the administrator.
errors.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.

account.title: Account
account.passwordDescription: Changing it signs you out on every other device.

dashboard.title: Good to see you, {name}
dashboard.description: A quick look at what’s happening.

users.title: Users
users.description: {count, plural, =0 {No users yet} one {# user} other {# users}}. Accounts are created by invitation only.
users.inviteDescription: They’ll get an email with a link to set their password. The link is valid for 7 days.

toast.inviteResent: A fresh invitation is on its way.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailTaken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.cannotModifySelf: You can’t change your own account here.
errors.onlyOwner: Only a super admin can change admin rights or act on another admin.
errors.ownerProtected: A super admin’s account can’t be changed from here.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.body: They’ll be signed out right away and can’t sign in again until you reactivate them.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.body: They’ll be able to sign in and use the library again.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: Their account is removed for good. This can’t be undone.

makeAdmin.title: Make {name} an admin?
makeAdmin.body: Admins can manage members and all content.

removeAdmin.title: Make {name} a member?
removeAdmin.body: They’ll lose access to the admin panel.

confirm.passwordHint: For changes to admin rights we ask for your password again.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Every change to accounts and admin rights, newest first. Only super admins can see this page.

empty.title: Nothing yet
empty.description: Changes to users will show up here.

actions.passwordCheckFailed: entered a wrong password while confirming an admin change

invitation.heading: Hello {name},
invitation.body: You’ve been invited to {brand}. Choose a password to activate your account.
invitation.footer: This link is valid for 7 days and can be used once. If you weren’t expecting this, you can ignore this email.
invitation.subject: You’re invited to {brand}

resetPassword.heading: Hello {name},
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your password. Use the button below to choose a new one.
resetPassword.footer: This link expires in one hour. If you didn’t ask for it, no action is needed.
resetPassword.subject: Reset your password

securityAlert.subject: Security notice from {brand}
securityAlert.preview: A change to admin rights on your site
securityAlert.heading: Hello {name},
securityAlert.footer: If this wasn’t you or someone you trust, change your password right away and remove any admin you don’t recognise.
